urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
param = (k, d) => urlParams.get(k) ?? d
setParam = (k, v) => { try { const u = new URL(window.location.href); if (v == null || v === "") u.searchParams.delete(k); else u.searchParams.set(k, v); history.replaceState(null, "", u); } catch (e) {} }

// tile map: data = [{st, v}]; calls onPick(st) on click
tileMap = (data, {color, fmt = f1, selected = null, onPick = null, w = 640} = {}) => {
  const byst = new Map(data.map(d => [d.st, d.v]));
  const cs = Math.min(52, (w - 10) / 12), H = cs * 8 + 10;
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("width", cs * 12 + 4).attr("height", H).attr("viewBox", [0, 0, cs * 12 + 4, H]).style("max-width", "100%").style("height", "auto").style("font-family", "inherit");
  const ok = s => byst.has(s) && byst.get(s) != null && isFinite(byst.get(s));
  const g = svg.selectAll("g").data(Object.entries(TILES)).join("g").attr("transform", ([s, [x, y]]) => `translate(${x * cs + 2},${y * cs + 2})`).style("cursor", onPick ? "pointer" : "default");
  g.append("rect").attr("width", cs - 3).attr("height", cs - 3).attr("rx", 4)
    .attr("fill", ([s]) => ok(s) ? color(byst.get(s)) : "#e6e9ec")
    .attr("stroke", ([s]) => s === selected ? INK : "none").attr("stroke-width", 2.5);
  const lum = c => { const r = d3.rgb(c); return 0.299 * r.r + 0.587 * r.g + 0.114 * r.b; };
  const tc = ([s]) => ok(s) && lum(color(byst.get(s))) < 140 ? "white" : INK;
  g.append("text").attr("x", (cs - 3) / 2).attr("y", cs * 0.4).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", cs * 0.27).attr("font-weight", 700).attr("fill", tc).text(([s]) => s);
  g.append("text").attr("x", (cs - 3) / 2).attr("y", cs * 0.72).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("font-size", cs * 0.21).attr("fill", tc).text(([s]) => ok(s) ? fmt(byst.get(s)) : "");
  g.append("title").text(([s]) => `${STNAME[s]}: ${ok(s) ? fmt(byst.get(s)) : "n/a"}`);
  if (onPick) g.on("click", (e, [s]) => onPick(s));
  return svg.node();
}
// set an Inputs view programmatically
setView = (v, value) => { v.value = value; v.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true})); }
// end-of-line labels that don't collide: rows = [{x, y, label}], returns rows with ly (label y) spread >= gap px
spreadLabels = (rows, {domain, height, gap = 12}) => {
  const [lo, hi] = domain, u = (hi - lo) / Math.max(1, height - 50) * gap;
  const r = rows.map(d => ({...d, ly: d.y})).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
  for (let i = 1; i < r.length; i++) if (r[i].ly - r[i - 1].ly < u) r[i].ly = r[i - 1].ly + u;
  const over = r.length ? r.at(-1).ly - hi : 0; if (over > 0) r.forEach(d => d.ly -= over);
  for (let i = r.length - 2; i >= 0; i--) if (r[i + 1].ly - r[i].ly < u) r[i].ly = r[i + 1].ly - u;
  return r;
}
// width helper: two-up on desktop, full width on phones
half = w => w > 820 ? w / 2 - 16 : w
